# GUI-LOP

> Human-in-the-loop workflow orchestration — DDD Node.js backend, React SPA, WebSocket realtime, JWT auth, SLO benchmarks.

GUI-LOP is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/GUI-LOP/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/adventurewave-labs/GUI-LOP): README, issues, releases
